decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out and maintained as such in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (791/403-C, 791/404-B Received 02/09/2011 and 791/405-A Received 03/08/2011 and 791/400-A, 791/401, 791/402-A, TR-HEYS/01-C, Planning, design & access and heritage statement Received 10/05/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use of the hereby permitted development shall remain ancillary to the main use of the dwellinghouse known as Ferry House, Park Road and shall be used for no other purposes.
description: Retrospective application for the retention of a stable building stables (including alterations) and erection of a greenhouse
